meta.title: Refactor PR #531 attribute filtering feature
meta.body_summary: Refactor attribute filtering feature from PR #531 with TypeScript type safety, component decomposition, React memoization, and scattergl performance improvements.

perf_labels.notes: Large refactor with perf claims; no human review, closed by bot after ~5h.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 7786 changed lines across 46 files, this is a large-by-volume refactor spanning frontend and backend. As a performance refactor PR, it was closed without merge—likely due to lack of maintainer engagement and too large a scope for automated review.

review_details.concern_detail: No human review or feedback; Devin bot auto-closed PR citing inactivity (though PR was open only ~5h).
review_details.performance_claim: React memoization and filter optimization improve UI performance.
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed by bot with 'Closing due to inactivity for more than 7 days' comment; no human interaction.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Large cross-language refactor with performance claims but no verifiable improvements; PR closed automatically due to lack of maintainer review, illustrating process breakdown when AI submissions are ignored.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after metrics; only narrative claims in PR body.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed by bot; no maintainer regression handling.

core_change_summary.description: Refactor attribute filtering across frontend (React) and backend (Python), introducing type safety improvements, component decomposition, memoization, and scattergl for better performance.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Large number of files touched due to merge commits and linting across experimental/ and server/.
change_trajectory: tokoroten initially built attribute filtering with range-slider UI, scatter chart improvements, and backend aggregation.
Subsequent commits refined filter behavior, empty string handling, and layout changes.
Devin AI joined, refactored for type safety, split components, fixed TypeScript errors, and replaced scatter with scattergl for performance.
PR closed automatically by Devin bot after ~5h with no human review.
